invariants.description: the vessels inflow reaches the imposed outflow at steady state (v_vessel → v, 0.1% or 1e-8 m^3/s)
vessel pressure settles at P_in − R v = 12000 − 1e7 v (±1 Pa)
vessel volume balance: q(t) − q(0) = ∫(v_vessel − v) dt (trapezoidal, 0.1%)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((va__q - va__q[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(((va__v) - (v))[1:] + ((va__v) - (v))[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-3*max(1e-12, np.max(np.abs(va__q - va__q[0])))

bc_sweep.rationale: Outflows from 0 to 9 L/min (0-1.5e-4 m^3/s), rest to exercise cardiac output. P is excluded: it is the pressure the connected vessel supplies (a port input).
